Chapter 05 · The person behind the work

  
Nice to
meet you.

  
I'm Marvellous Christopher. I studied Computer Engineering at the University of Benin and trained in post-production and animation at Del-York Creative Academy, so I've always had one foot in creativity and the other in tech.

  
In 2022, I started MarvelC. Today I work as a creative full-time, and together with my team I take on projects for brands, churches and businesses. When you work with me, I care about the small details as much as the big picture.
